dedupe_keys.name: planar trench geothermal thermal response test april 2023

description: The planar-trench collector team publishes a second 2023 thermal response campaign from 6 to 13 April. Coverage is one collector during that week. The measurements can calibrate heat-transfer simulation inputs. The Zenodo record lists a calibrated PT100 temperature CSV and a sensor-metadata CSV. Its description identifies when fluid circulation and heat injection started and stopped under a stated constant-flow test. Public files are free under CC BY 4.0. These measurements can help compare short-term ground heat transfer under different seasonal conditions and calibrate a shallow-geothermal component in a building model such as model-energyplus. A caveat is that differences from the February campaign may reflect moisture, initial ground temperature, control settings or sensor processing, not a single changed material property. The own metadata and file list were read, but temperature values, sensor positions and model fits were not checked. The deposit has its own DOI and remains distinct from the other trench tests.
